requestKey: What is the best stretching app?|sway.day|sample1

payload.text:
Short answer: there isn’t one “best” stretching app for everyone. It depends on your goal and budget. My quick picks (as of August 4, 2026):

- Build a simple daily habit, low cost: Bend. Clean timers and premade routines for AM/PM, posture, hips, hamstrings; free to download with inexpensive memberships shown in‑app (e.g., Monthly $4.99–$13.99; occasional discounted annuals). The App Store also shows 4.8★ with ~172K ratings, and Bend says 15M+ users. ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bend-stretching-flexibility/id1513988468))
- Structured, coached flexibility (splits, deeper backbends): StretchIt. Instructor‑led video classes, programs, and a 7‑day trial. Current list price: $24.99/month or $179.99/year. ([blog.stretchitapp.com](https://blog.stretchitapp.com/?utm_source=openai))
- Athlete‑style mobility and recovery with daily guided sessions: pliability (formerly ROMWOD). Daily 12–20 min routines, big video library, and an on‑device mobility test; available on iOS/Android/web/Apple TV. Current price: $22.95/month or $199.95/year. ([pliability.com](https://pliability.com/targets/mobility?utm_source=openai))
- Personalized protocols after an assessment: GOWOD. Starts with a free mobility test and builds routines around your weak points; premium unlocks the full library (pricing varies by region/in‑app). ([gowod.app](https://www.gowod.app/faq?utm_source=openai))
- 100% free library with mobility and yoga: Nike Training Club. Large catalogue of free workouts including mobility, recovery, and yoga sessions. ([nike.com](https://www.nike.com/hr/ntc-app?lang=en&utm_source=openai))

How to choose fast:
- Want coached, video‑class feel and don’t mind a higher price? Pick pliability.
- Want a simple, low‑friction daily stretch you’ll actually stick with? Try Bend.
- Training for clear flexibility goals (e.g., front/middle splits)? StretchIt.
- Want an assessment‑driven plan? GOWOD.
- Want free and good enough? Nike Training Club.

If you tell me your main goal (e.g., back‑pain relief, desk stiffness, splits, CrossFit support), your device (iOS/Android), and free vs paid, I’ll narrow it to one or two best fits for you.
